title: Idearium Idea
description: The atomic input to the idea OS. Every system capability starts here. Not a note. Not a todo. An idea is a JAA node with causal ancestry, tension score, and an optional linked spec. Single writer: idearium.core. Read by: spec-builder, tension scorer, vortex, CI gate.

text.description: The idea in plain language. One sentence minimum.

tags.description: Semantic tags. Free-form. Used for search, routing, and lattice connection.

phase.description: Lifecycle phase. Seed=raw. Expanding=being developed. Tensioned=friction scored. Specced=spec written. Building=in gate runner. Complete=artifacts delivered. Archived=set aside (not deleted — §M1).

tension.description: Tension score 0-1. High tension = idea is generating friction, pulling for resolution. Computed by tension engine.

parentIdea.description: UUID of parent idea — for idea trees

linkedSpec.description: UUID of the spec derived from this idea

resonanceWith.description: UUIDs of ideas that correspond with or reinforce this idea

tensionWith.description: UUIDs of ideas in active friction with this idea (competing approaches, contradictions)

openGaps.description: UUIDs of open gaps associated with this idea

stability.description: Five stability dimensions from memory layer (1.0 = baseline, > 1.0 = above baseline, < 0.5 = degraded)

causedBy.description: UUID of the event, CLI command, or other idea that caused this idea to be created

source.description: Module that created this idea (usually 'idearium.core' or 'cli')
